component.name: Widget Studio
component.summary: Design desktop widgets and pin them to your screen

description.p: Make your own clock, weather, calendar and system stats widgets and put them on your desktop. Change colors, fonts, size and position and watch the widget update live.

ul.li: Clock and date with any time zone
Weather from Open-Meteo with a city search, no account or API key
Ready-made themes, including a Nothing-style dot-matrix look

description.p: Works on COSMIC, KDE Plasma and X11 desktops such as Cinnamon and XFCE. Widgets are drawn by Conky.

ul.li: Updating is now just installing the new package: the background updater notices the new version and restarts itself
The calendar always lines up, even with fonts that aren't monospace
Widgets restart by themselves when a font they use gets installed
Starting and stopping widgets can no longer race into doubled widgets
